command: Close the pinned padded 1x5x5x3 four-channel fused Conv bias plus scale0.5 plus ReLU mode. Execute only raw_loop_conv(mode=1), independently implement Gemmini RNE scale and ReLU for all 100 outputs, verify its nine CUSTOM_3 payloads against conv_relu_requant descriptor-v2 vectors, and reuse the case-2 transport geometry with the extra quant descriptor record reflected in descriptor-byte accounting. Record payload and canonical metrics separately.
success_condition: Pinned dependency and weight hashes are recorded; deterministic INT8 GEMM cases are elementwise bit-exact from operator golden through production descriptor RTL and canonical L3 top; reported RTL cycles/DMA bytes/utilization/conflicts come from counters rather than analysis estimates; all builds/tests remain CPU 8-25, max j4 and under the 10 GiB cap.
failure_policy: Do not skip ahead to model blocks, use analytical numbers in RTL-measured fields, substitute the 4x16 Gaussian baseline for the required production 4x4 AHA/Lake, relax integer equality, change the frozen descriptor/quantization contract, or mark L4 PASS before every ordered subgate is complete.
